info.title: SLSEA Solar Generation API
info.description: SLSEA Solar Generation API, Stages 1–6 and 8. Public health and OpenAPI; JWT-protected hierarchy, immutable ingestion, scoped history, operational reads and district generation summaries. Current paths are relative to the host root. Business GET/HEAD uses authorized ETag revalidation. Mutable CRUD clarification and deployment remain outstanding.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Public process and database readiness checks.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Exchange a local credential for a short-lived bearer token.

tags.name: Hierarchy
tags.description: Analyst-only geography and installation resources filtered by JWT jurisdiction.

tags.name: Readings
tags.description: Immutable measurements. Devices append their own readings; analysts read only within their jurisdiction.

tags.name: Summaries
tags.description: Jurisdiction-scoped power/energy aggregates with explicit measurement coverage.

get.summary: Check that the API process is running
get.description: Reports process liveness without querying the database. A database outage does not make this endpoint fail. Health probes are not cacheable and ignore conditional caching headers so they always report current health.

Runs a bounded database connectivity check. Connection details and database errors are never returned. This foundation check does not assert that business tables or seed data exist. Health probes are not cacheable and ignore conditional caching headers so they always report current health.

post.summary: Append a reading for the authenticated installation
post.description: Requires readings:write, an active installation principal matching the URL, and current credential version. Unknown fields and excessive precision return 40002. Repeated timestamps return 40901; inconsistent cumulative counters return 40902. Per-installation transaction locks serialize API ingestion. Meter resets are unsupported. Devices receive the created representation but cannot GET Location with a device token. GET history is available to analysts; Allow is GET, HEAD, POST, OPTIONS. Conditional headers are supported on GET/HEAD, not this ingestion operation.

201.description: Created immutable observation. Location and Content-Location identify the analyst-readable canonical resource.

get.description: Requires installation:read and an active analyst. Count and page use one REPEATABLE READ snapshot. Unknown/repeated parameters return 400. Empty results and beyond-end offsets return 200. Regional hidden/nonexistent filters produce an empty page; a hidden/nonexistent nested installation returns 404. Offset pages can shift between requests; a fixed time window still permits late-arriving backfill. GET supports bodyless HEAD. Hierarchy resources use ETags; no Last-Modified is invented for directories lacking a complete membership-change clock.

get.summary: Summarize district power and local-day energy with coverage
get.description: Requires installation:read and an active national analyst or analyst assigned to the containing province/this district. Absent and hidden districts both return 404. One SQL snapshot selects each site’s latest observation at/before cutoff and its exact Asia/Colombo midnight baseline. Future observations are excluded. All current inventory installations (including inactive) contribute to the denominator. Historical replay uses the currently stored dataset, so late backfill can change past summaries. No Last-Modified is emitted: time-dependent freshness and inventory cannot be represented by latest receipt time. ETags include asOf and the complete response; GET/HEAD can return 304 after authorization. Empty districts return 200 with null totals and false completeness. HEAD/OPTIONS supported; writes return 405. This is a measured snapshot, not a continuous live-power guarantee.

parameters.description: Optional inclusive cutoff, on/after Unix epoch and never future. Seconds, timezone and at most three fractional digits required. Default: current 15-minute slot start. Unknown or repeated parameters return 400; URL-encode + as %2B.

200.description: Scoped measured subtotals and coverage, with explicit observation bounds.

304.description: Authorized summary unchanged for its cutoff; no body.

RequestId.description: A server-generated UUID for correlating this response with application logs. For errors, it matches error.requestId.

NoStore.description: Foundation health, documentation and error responses must not be stored by caches.

Allow.description: Methods supported by the target resource.

RepresentationTag.description: Strong SHA-256 validator of the serialized representation. Mutable views include URL and jurisdiction context. Authorization is always checked before preconditions.

RepresentationModified.description: HTTP-date from stored receipt/modification times, not observation time. Milliseconds are retained internally for conservative date comparisons.

PrivateRevalidation.description: Private caches must revalidate authenticated representations.

field.description: The input field or dependency associated with the error, when applicable.

code.description: Numeric application error code; the first three digits identify the HTTP status.

details.description: Safe error details; an empty array when there is no additional detail.

timestamp.description: Seconds and timezone required, at most three fractional digits. On or after Unix epoch and commissioning date in Asia/Colombo; at most five minutes ahead of server time. Backfill must fit both counter neighbours.

Seconds and timezone required, at most three fractional digits. On or after Unix epoch and commissioning date in Asia/Colombo; at most five minutes ahead of server time. Backfill must fit both counter neighbours.

receivedAt.description: Server receipt time; latest selection uses observation time.

count.description: Total authorized and filtered count, independent of page length.

next.description: Relative next-page URL retaining all validated filters and sort.

previous.description: Relative previous-page URL; beyond-end pages link to the final valid page.

asOf.description: Inclusive observation cutoff in UTC. Default is the current 15-minute slot start.

dayStart.description: Asia/Colombo local midnight for the cutoff, serialized in UTC.

measuredPowerKw.description: Sum of latest powers no more than 30 minutes old at cutoff. Null when none are fresh; zero is a measured value. This is a subtotal if coverage is incomplete.

energyTodayKwh.description: Sum of per-site latest-counter minus exact midnight-counter, including stale but otherwise usable observations. Null when no site qualifies; not a sum of cumulative counters.

powerCoverageComplete.description: True only for a nonempty district where every installation has a fresh observation.

energyCoverageComplete.description: True only for a nonempty district where every installation has an exact midnight baseline and a nondecreasing latest counter. Does not imply freshness; see staleEnergyInstallations and time bounds.

totalInstallations.description: All installations in the current district inventory, including inactive installations; not a reconstructed historical inventory.

freshInstallations.description: Latest observation is at or before cutoff and at most 30 minutes old (inclusive).

staleInstallations.description: Latest observation exists at cutoff but is more than 30 minutes old.

noReadingInstallations.description: No observation at or before cutoff (future rows do not count).

energyContributingInstallations.description: Sites with an exact midnight baseline and a nondecreasing latest counter.

missingMidnightBaselineInstallations.description: Sites lacking an observation exactly at local midnight, including sites without any observations.

invalidCounterInstallations.description: Sites with a latest counter below their midnight baseline; excluded from the energy sum.

staleEnergyInstallations.description: Energy contributors whose latest observation is stale.

powerOldestObservedAt.description: Bounds of contributing latest observations for this subtotal, or null when none qualify.

powerNewestObservedAt.description: Bounds of contributing latest observations for this subtotal, or null when none qualify.

energyOldestObservedAt.description: Bounds of contributing latest observations for this subtotal, or null when none qualify.

energyNewestObservedAt.description: Bounds of contributing latest observations for this subtotal, or null when none qualify.

InvalidRequest.description: 40001: The request is invalid, including malformed JSON.

NotFound.description: 40401: No resource exists at the requested path. Business endpoints are not implemented in Stage 1.

MethodNotAllowed.description: 40501: The target resource does not support the requested method. See Allow for supported methods.

NotAcceptable.description: 40601: The Accept header excludes application/json. The error response uses the standard JSON error representation.

PayloadTooLarge.description: 41301: The request body exceeds the configured size limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: 41501: The request body has an unsupported media type, character encoding or content encoding.

InternalServerError.description: 50001: An unexpected error occurred. Responses exclude stack traces, credentials and internal diagnostics.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required scope.

ReadingConflict.description: 40901: duplicate timestamp (identical or conflicting). 40902: cumulative counter decreases relative to either immediate neighbour. Existing readings are never changed.

error.message: A reading already exists for this installation and timestamp
Cumulative energy conflicts with surrounding observations

details.message: Counter must not decrease in observation-time order; meter resets are unsupported

PreconditionFailed.description: 41201: a strong If-Match or applicable If-Unmodified-Since precondition failed after authentication, authorization and resource lookup.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived HS256 token issued by POST /auth/token.
